The '''Atrium''' was a public building located in [[Ord Mynock Freeport]], the only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the<ref name="LARP">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mynockra system]]</ref> planet [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].<ref name="LARP" /> It was designed to appeal to tourists, travellers, and citizens. A reinforced triangular glass enclosure, the Atrium had displays of [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock's]] fauna and flora. The Atrium also included displays of non-native creatures, including [[hover beak]]s from [[Rynmar]], a [[red-crested aviar swooper]] from [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]], [[cappabellor beetle]]s from [[Malador/Legends|Malador]], and [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] and [[Cloud fly|cloud flies]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Atrium was introduced in ''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]'', a [[West End Games]] sourcebook written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony Russo]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="LARP" />
